identity.tagline: A private site for personal use.

seo.title: Jordan Bennett
seo.description: Jordan Bennett’s private site. Locked behind a password, built for personal use.

sections.heading: Jordan Bennett
sections.subheading: This is your private homepage. Only you can open it. Ask the builder to change a heading, a color, or a section — it updates for you alone.

sections.heading: What this space is for
sections.subheading: A private page for Jordan Bennett. Tools on this site are for you, not a shop.

items.title: A private homepage
items.body: The whole site asks for your password. Nobody else can open these pages.

items.title: A locked studio
items.body: Open /studio after you sign in. That is where you talk to the designer and save instantly.

items.title: Live customizations
items.body: Tell the builder what to change. The page updates for you, and only you see it.

sections.heading: A short note about you.
sections.body: This site is for Jordan Bennett’s personal use. Replace this with your story when you want. It is not a shop, and nobody else can see it.

sections.heading: Say hello
sections.body: Add your email, phone, or city in the studio and this block will fill itself in.

sections.heading: URL maker
sections.body: Type a name. I search the public internet. If the .com is free, buy it at GoDaddy so that official address works on every phone, app, and browser.

sections.heading: URL scanner
sections.body: Paste a link someone sent you. The answer is YES or NO.

sections.heading: Name scanner
sections.body: Type a name. YES means someone else already uses it publicly. NO means no public match, or it is the owner of this site.

sections.heading: Currency calculator
sections.body: Type a country or currency on both sides, like Canada to Japan. Convert either way and see every live rate.

sections.heading: Notebook
sections.body: Save a person’s name, business, phone number, and email. Only you can see this list.
